migration.description: Upgrade the host-local Connector journal with explicit session-creation identity and a forward-readable format boundary.
migration.release_unit_description: Phase-one Connector local journal format v2.

durable_state.description: Append-only JSONL records for commands, ACK updates, host-owned session identities, observed app-server events and reconciliation outcomes.
durable_state.storage_implementation: Mode-0600 journal file inside a mode-0700 host-local directory.

required_test_evidence: v1 records round-trip through the journal reader
v1 session-start records do not satisfy a new explicit creation identity
v2 session-start records persist command_id and payload digest
v2 records are rejected by the v1 reader boundary
a torn final write is truncated safely
accepted and executing commands become unknown after restart
unknown outcomes require explicit reconciliation and are never replayed
minor.note: The candidate reads the immediately preceding v1 journal state; v1 binaries are not supported readers for v2 records.

major.note: Direct major skips are rejected by format-version validation.
